parsed.post: Discarding the 0.993386 run. Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 was correct, but it seems the combination with current hyperparameters regressed from my previous best of 0.982464. Reverting to f04fbc4. Next, I'll test increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.06 on the f04fbc4 stack to see if we can find a better convergence speed.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 on the DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 stack to accelerate convergence.
